arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 -c "
import os
total=0; entries=0
for base,dirs,files in os.walk('.'):
    for name in dirs+files:
        entries+=1
        p=os.path.join(base,name)
        if os.path.isfile(p) and not os.path.islink(p):
            total+=os.path.getsize(p)
print('entries', entries, '(limit 512)')
print('bytes', total, '=', round(total/1024,1), 'KiB (limit 16 MiB)')
" && find . -type f | sort
